mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_chapter (book_id, chapter_name, chapter_num, word_count, create_time) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{chapterName}, #{chapterNum}, COALESCE(#{wordCount}, 0), #{createTime})

mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.book_id, c.chapter_name, c.chapter_num, c.word_count, c.audit_status, c.reject_reason, c.create_time, b.book_name AS bookName FROM book_chapter c JOIN book_info b ON b.id = c.book_id WHERE c.audit_status = #{auditStatus} ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
